propositions: With undeclared file_impact, the system must record the normalized read-set (paths actually fetched during LLM review) in the signed manifest and reject attestations with tampered read-set metadata.

When all four preconditions hold (empty pre-existing scope, no container poison, undeclared ticket, read-set observed), SHA drift invalidation must be scoped to the union of read-set and blast-radius paths (configs, rubrics, criteria, workflow), not all code changes.

Glob patterns in the dependency set must be expanded at attestation time and tracked via membership digest (sorted match list hash) to catch file additions/deletions under expanded globs, not just content drift of individual files.
Verification failure, unobserved/pre-change read-set, or basis resolution/expansion error must fall back to invalidate-on-any-SHA-change (fail-safe), never silently accept drift.
The signed manifest must record an authenticated currency-basis line (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) indicating which scope mechanism applied at sign time.
Tickets with declared-none scope or existing non-empty file_impact must never gain read-set or blast-radius scope, ensuring fail-closed behavior and no regression of prior exemptions.
